title: Towards Investigating Residual Hearing Loss: Quantification of Fibrosis in a Novel Cochlear OCT Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2608.21189v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Objective: Cochlear implants (CIs) are bionic prostheses that restores hearing via electrical stimulation of the auditory nerve. Hybrid CIs, which use electroacoustic stimulation (EAS), combine residual low-frequency acoustic hearing with CI electrical stimulation. Intracochlear fibrosis, which forms in response to the presence of the implant, may impede residual hearing function and gradually reduce the efficacy of EAS. It is therefore a translational objective to study the formation of cochlear fibrosis in rodents, with the goal of reducing fibrotic burden and improving outcomes for CI patients. Methods: We generate and annotate a novel dataset of optical coherence tomography (OCT) images from chronically implanted guinea pigs as part of an ongoing study focused on implant induced fibrosis. Objectively assessing fibrotic burden in this model, with high resolution and repeatability, presents an obvious use case for computer vision met

translated_title: 探究残余听力损失：新型耳蜗OCT数据集中纤维化的量化研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21189v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：目的：人工耳蜗（CI）是一种通过电刺激听神经恢复听力的仿生假体。混合人工耳蜗（Hybrid CIs）采用电声刺激（EAS），将残余低频声学听力与CI电刺激相结合。植入物存在引发的耳蜗内纤维化可能阻碍残余听力功能，并逐渐降低EAS的疗效。因此，研究啮齿动物耳蜗纤维化的形成是一个转化医学目标，旨在减少纤维化负担并改善CI患者的预后。方法：我们生成并标注了一个新型光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像数据集，来自慢性植入的豚鼠，作为一项专注于植入物诱导纤维化的持续研究的一部分。在该模型中客观评估纤维化负担，具有高分辨率和可重复性，为计算机视觉度量提供了明显的应用场景。
tldr: 本文创建并标注了一个新型耳蜗OCT图像数据集，用于量化慢性植入豚鼠中的纤维化，以支持混合人工耳蜗残余听力损失的研究。
en_tdlr: This paper creates and annotates a novel cochlear OCT image dataset to quantify fibrosis in chronically implanted guinea pigs, supporting research on residual hearing loss in hybrid cochlear implants.
